reviews.text:
★★★★★

A huge thank you to Angelina for her excellent work with Sydney and Sushi while we were away. She is always available, punctual, reliable, and incredibly attentive to our cats. It's immediately clear that she loves animals: Sydney and Sushi adore her and are always calm and collected with her.

We have complete confidence in Angelina, who cares for them as if they were her own. It's such a relief to be able to go on vacation knowing they are in good hands. We recommend her without hesitation!

Angelina has been looking after Mouchette, my cat, for a year now, every time I go on vacation. She's amazing, and Mouchette adores her. Not only does she have a wonderful way with animals, but she also takes such good care of her (she even had to give her Ventolin for a while!). They play, cuddle... When I get back, Mouchette is healthy and very happy!

I highly recommend her! She's been my cat's dedicated sitter since he was a kitten, and I couldn't ask for better.

She's looked after him several times at my home, and everything has always gone perfectly. I trust her completely, both to take care of my cat and to give her my house keys, which is very reassuring.

She's very professional, attentive, and always takes the time to provide a report on the Rover app with photos and updates after each visit. This is a real bonus that allows me to be completely at ease while I'm away.

In addition to being reliable, she's very accommodating and flexible. I use her services every time without hesitation and recommend her without the slightest doubt. Thank you again, Angelina, for your kindness and professionalism!

Angelina has walked my dog ​​about ten times this past year, and each time it went wonderfully. We get photos and messages at the beginning and end of each walk, and her strong connection with animals is truly evident. I highly recommend her!

Viviane is on high alert! She knows she's about to meet more than just a pet sitter, because Angelina is arriving with her energy, enthusiasm, and genuine respect for her profession, which inspires her to truly love our pets! Viviane is on high alert and is about to experience a wonderful bonding moment.
Thank you, Angelina, for Viviane, and I hope that other Vivianes will be waiting for you to share many more wonderful moments of play and tenderness.

It's been over four months now that Angelina has been walking our dog Dolly twice a week! She's kind, gentle, and attentive. Since she started walking Dolly, I've really seen a difference.
After each walk, there's a little report and photos/videos, and when she comes home, she never forgets to give our cat a little cuddle. You can tell she truly loves animals, and that makes all the difference. Thank you so much, Angelina! ☺️

A reliable, caring, attentive, accommodating, and lovely pet sitter. My dog ​​adores her, and I feel completely confident and reassured when I leave my dog ​​in her care. We receive numerous photos and videos during her visits, and she is very responsive to any instructions we give. 100% recommended!

I'm so happy to have found Angelina to look after my Vico and take him for walks. She's very gentle and attentive to Vico, adapting the walks according to the weather and your pet's needs. Very accommodating and available! Vico adores her and is always happy when she comes to see him. I highly recommend her! ☺️
Angelina took wonderful care of our cat while we were away. You can entrust your pet to her without hesitation. She immediately gained our cat's trust, and he clearly enjoyed her company.

Angelina has been taking care of my cat for several years now. She's passionate about animals and has built a real relationship with me. She also has a solid understanding of animal behavior, which makes her a valuable resource in my cat's life. I have complete confidence in Angelina, who is exceptionally professional (always available, punctual, and leaves the place spotless).
